name: Semantic Shift to Interval Geometry
description: The problem is reframed from physical hardware resources to the geometric properties of the scheduled intervals themselves. By defining "serial groups" of temporally exclusive intervals, the required sums are presented as the total length of non-overlapping segments rather than the load on a machine. This removes the "bottleneck resource" keywords that models rely on, forcing them to map the abstract set definitions to the corresponding arithmetic sums.
